about: What is inside things in Kingswood, rolled the first time the player looks (dungeon/finds.py). Each container kind names the words a player uses for it, how many draws it gets, and a weighted table: an item from the town's catalog (world/data/items/kingswood.json), coins in silver crowns (a range), a note the narrator describes, or nothing. A note marked trap is a trap that was there before anyone looked.

table.note: a bundle of letters tied with twine, the top one addressed to someone at Gannet & Pryce
a spring needle in the lock, its tip dark with something
a tally of felled timber with two sets of numbers that do not agree
a pressed oak leaf wrapped in a scrap of grey cloth
a nest of rats, who object
a chit stamped with the Timber Guild's mark and a number
a wound that no blade made: three parallel scores, deep and clean
a lucky charm: a bent nail on a thong
a loose floorboard with nothing under it but dust and a smell of earth
a cold draught from a crack in the wall that runs toward the Heartwood
